display_name: Phase1 independent prior-guided blind inverse source validation
description: Source-only fixed validation of learned clean IQ prior with blind independent channel, multi-step observation consistency, and frozen F.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU4 source-only fixed model evaluation; TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Blind action posterior plus three observation/learned prior updates; no DURA in candidate
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No source true identity labels, simulated channel truth, U_s truth, V or test in this validation; clean-F pseudo labels only
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source validation and 3921 RX8 source holdout IDs, all physical IDs previously observed in other views; frozen clean F pseudo labels only

permissions.query_use: Source clean F high-confidence pseudo targets only; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or test.
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-trained SignalPrior, source-only blind channel and six-class Gaussian source prior, gate .8; DURA comparator only.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Independent prior training commit aad511295e734e616770609ab96c2ff5ab008aa7; independent blind source estimator 94693a342bb2daa684c0f21415d7b949f9fb2107 and frozen source prior.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Before prior training completes, fixed 3 prior-correction strengths and 2 gates; RX4/6 classification and IQ guard vs parent and DURA, net gain >=10; RX8 heldout. Ground test always for full model.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU4 single owner; fixed model source inference; TF32 disabled

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Frozen clean F pseudo targets, per-cell classification and aligned IQ guard, no TX identity truth or target.
